facts.fact: TechTrendsKE says the ODPC was established under the Data Protection Act 2019 and Immaculate Kassait served as Kenya's first Data Commissioner until her successor's nomination on 10 November 2026.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: Kassait says the ODPC took enforcement actions against the Ministry of Agriculture and Migori County Assembly, with no date given.
